name: Cone
summary: Calibrate and control speaker systems from 2.0 up to 7.1.4, with a simple interface, powerful processing and a dedicated iPad remote.
features: Cone Remote for iPad moves control off the computer screen
Multiple iPads can connect to one Mac

name: Paddle
summary: Arming and input/output switching for Pro Tools, with routing of arming to one or many print master tracks.
features: Route arming to one or many print masters
iPad interface over the local network
As many computers or iPads as you need

name: Conduit
tagline: Send and return insert for Pro Tools
summary: Route named audio outputs to external apps without aux I/Os, and return audio from external apps with as many channels as you need.
features: Conduit Send and Conduit Return inserts
Appears as an input/output to Core Audio apps

name: Silencer
tagline: Mute or dim, by key or MIDI
summary: Mute or dim a track from a keystroke or MIDI command, with latch or momentary modes and toggle and reverse combinations.

name: Transmitter Network
tagline: Audio between computers over your LAN
summary: Send audio between computers over a local network with low latency. Includes a Receiver app for systems without Pro Tools.
features: Receiver app for computers without Pro Tools
Low latency on a local network

name: Channel
tagline: The whole channel strip in one insert
summary: A complete processing chain for Pro Tools in a single insert: EQ, compressor and de-esser, tuned for dialogue and post.

name: Gauge
summary: Integrated loudness, true peak and short-term levels, right on the track.
